frozen: 7 Oct 2026, before any held-out (leaf parity 1) scoring of the selected views
kill: P3 fails (a real text, names and all, reaches the Voynich level) or P1 fails in two transcriptions

predictions.P1: ZL3b, IT2a and GC2a: median held-out accuracy of the 20 selected views >= 0.75 and >= 15/20 views with z >= 3
predictions.P2: ZL3b, IT2a and GC2a: median held-out far accuracy (only candidates > 4 pages apart) >= 0.72 (not neighbour drift)
predictions.P3: each Voynich median held-out accuracy exceeds the largest median held-out accuracy of the five plants (P_KONRAD, P_CIRCA, P_APIC, P_HYGIN, P_CULP)

statistic: mean normalised rank of the true page when a page's recurring units are scored against the glyph log-ratio profiles of same-group pages (rest of page, own recurring units removed); far = candidates more than 4 pages apart in corpus order excluded; z vs 200 within-group relabellings
